exclusions.description: List of file names or directory prefixes to be excluded from licenserecon checks. Entries are file paths or directory names as they appear in the package source tree relative to the debian/ directory or root.

aliases.description: List of license alias mappings to resolve false positives. Each item is a map with 'key' (the detected or desired short name) and 'value' (the target license short name). This overrides the default DEP-5 or SPDX naming conventions where configured in lrc.config syntax.
